title: Snow-white and straight ahead
goal: Use the doubled colours for completely, adjectives as adverbs, and compare how people do things.

intro.text: Some colours double for **completely**: *ap-ak*, pure white; *gap-gara*, jet black. An adjective before a verb says how: *gowy gürleýär*, speaks well; *çalt sürýär*, drives fast. *ýuwaş-ýuwaş* is **little by little**.

why.1: The doubled form takes the word up to its first vowel and adds *p*: *ap-ak*.
why.2: It is written with a hyphen: *ap-ak*.
